info.name: Retrieve a list of academic years within the Univesity.

params.name: mode
params.description: Mode of retrieving the list of year. Options are "current","between" and "amount". For "current" mode, it returns the current academic year in a single object. For "between" mode, input parameters "from" and "to" are used. (e.g. "from=2023&to=2033"). For "amount" mode, input parameters "from" and "numofyears" are used. (e.g. "from=2023&numofyears=12").

params.name: from
params.description: Using with "between" or "amount" mode. Selected year to start from (e.g. 2023). Default value is current academic year.

params.name: to
params.description: Using with "between" mode. Selected year to end (inclustive) (e.g. 2033).

params.name: numofyears
params.description: Using with "amount" mode. Number of years to return. It can be a positive number (select N years forward) or a negative number (select N years backward) (e.g. 12, -12)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorts the data by column name, use "-" for descending

params.name: limit
params.description: Using without mode. Number of years to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Using without mode. Offset of years to return
